purpose: Teach: 艦隊/傲慢/天体/ホームレス/天下り/君が代/樹木/爆撃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海運業界の艦隊管理ノウハウを学べ
lines.en: Learn our expertise in maritime fleet management.
lines.style: Direct, commanding. A quick opening attack—no hesitation. Clipped pace with weight on each directive. The voice of someone used to being listened to immediately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、傲慢な態度を絶対に取らない方針です
lines.en: Yes. Our company policy is never to adopt an arrogant stance.
lines.style: Measured affirmation. Even delivery on the acknowledgment. Slight pause before the policy statement—careful precision, like he's confirming the principle aloud. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、天体望遠鏡メーカーへの投資を検討しろ
lines.en: Look into an investment opportunity with the telescope manufacturer.
lines.style: Directive tone, still commanding but slightly less terse than the first line. A light tap of emphasis on the action verb. Expectant pause at the end—waiting for confirmation it's been heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ホームレス支援団体への寄付を検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll consider a donation to the homeless support organization.
lines.style: Acknowledgment followed by commitment. Spoken with clear intention—not defensive, just clear about what he'll do. Steady, reliable tone. No flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役員の天下り受け入れには慎重になれ
lines.en: Be cautious about accepting executive transfers to our company.
lines.style: Warning weight behind the words. Slow, deliberate pace on the caution. The tone of experience—he's seen this before. Slight trailing emphasis on the final phrase, like a quiet counsel.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。式典では君が代斉唱の段取りを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the logistics for the national anthem at the ceremony.
lines.style: Efficient, competent acknowledgment. Light, almost administrative tone—the confidence of handling details well. Clipped at the end, ready to move to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、敷地の樹木保全を社員と進めろ
lines.en: Our company will advance tree conservation on the grounds together with staff.
lines.style: Principled directive with a collaborative edge. Warm undertone beneath the command—this isn't imposed from above, it's 'together.' Measured pace, weight on the stewardship aspect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。戦時爆撃跡地の保護活動にも協賛します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also sponsor protection activities at the wartime bombing site.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation with added initiative. Slower pace on the second clause—he's offering something beyond what was asked. Quiet dignity in the tone. Soft close, like a genuine commitment.
